comment: Main drawing is the Fuzz Central schematic (image 3). The post also shows the Geofex drawing 'Vox Tone Bender 5/67' (image 2), which differs: 0.22uF input cap, a 2.2K + 8.2K collector divider with the 3.3nF output cap taken from their junction, a 47K and 500K output network, and 25uF on the Attack pot. No designators on either drawing except Q1/Q2; resistors and caps numbered here left to right.
